name: Accutron
old_description: electronic printed circuit board assembly. Our reputation is founded upon over 35 years
about:
Accutron operates from a 55,000-square-foot facility in Windsor, Connecticut. The company was established in 1989 and has built a reputation in contract manufacturing for electronic printed circuit board assembly. In September 2024, Accutron became part of Foxtronics EMS, expanding its capabilities and industry visibility.

The company provides full-service contract manufacturing spanning SMT and thru-hole PCB assembly, box build, engineering services including design for manufacturability and testability, component-level programming, and comprehensive testing through flying probe, in-circuit, functional, and burn-in platforms. A dedicated quick-turn prototype line supports rapid iteration, while material management and supply chain services streamline production from prototype to full-scale volumes.

Accutron serves aerospace, medical, and telecommunications sectors, holding AS9100 and ISO 13485 certifications alongside ITAR registration. Its web-based data collection system addresses Class III medical and aerospace traceability requirements, providing component-level lot control through full work order history by assembly number.

The company emphasizes simplifying complex technologies through a proactive management approach, competitive pricing, and swift time-to-market delivery. Its traceability infrastructure and quick-turn prototype capability are positioned as core differentiators for customers needing reliable, high-mix electronic manufacturing in the Northeast.
